answers.question: Does AHU-1 run as designed?
answers.text:
Whether AHU01 (AHU-1) [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* actually runs as designed in operation is unknown because there is no live BMS data [[check:live|unit:AHU1]] [[m-0007]], and on paper its setup has problems in 4 of 7 diagnostic steps:

- **Sequence (ok):** AHU01 [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* follows the "Air Handling Unit" sequence on sheet M-304 [[seq:air-handling-unit]] [[src:3_sequences.pdf#p1]].
- **Control loops (problem):** 3 of 6 loops (economizer [[seq:air-handling-unit/G]], preheat [[seq:air-handling-unit/I]], humidification [[seq:air-handling-unit/J]]) have matching points and classes, while 3 loops (duct static pressure [[seq:air-handling-unit/E]], building pressure [[seq:air-handling-unit/F]], cooling discharge air temperature [[seq:air-handling-unit/K]]) have analog outputs misclassified as sensors: SF-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.SF-O]] *unsure* [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.SF-O]], EF1-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF1-O]] *unsure* [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF1-O]], EF2-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF2-O]] *unsure* [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF2-O]], and CHWV-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]] *unsure* [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]].
- **Interlocks (ok):** All 26 published interlocks, safeties, modes, and plant requests have their points on the unit [[seq:air-handling-unit/C]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/E]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/F]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/G]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/I]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/J]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/K]] [[seq:air-handling-unit/L]] [[seq:chilled-water-system/A]] [[seq:chilled-water-system/B]] [[seq:exhaust-fans/B]].
- **Setpoints (problem):** 4 sequence values agree with the BMS and schedule (BLDGP-SP at +0.02 in.wc [[check:setpoint.F|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.BLDGP-SP]], preheat MA-SP at 55 °F [[check:setpoint.I|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.MA-SP]], HUM-SP at 45 %RH [[check:setpoint.J|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.HUM-SP]], and DA-SP at 53 °F [[check:setpoint.K|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DA-SP]] [[src:2_equipment_schedules.pdf#p1]]), while 3 do not: MA-SP is 55 °F in the BMS vs. 60 °F in the economizer sequence [[check:setpoint.G|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.MA-SP]] [[m-0001]], DAP-SP is "set by TAB" with no value [[check:setpoint.E|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DAP-SP]], and the 25% freeze-protection flow in section L has no setpoint point [[check:setpoint.L|unit:AHU1]].
- **Checks (problem):** 8 checks fail on AHU01 [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed*: 1 SHACL location rule failure on `floor:RF` [[check:shacl.Entity|unit:AHU1]] and 7 analog outputs misclassified as sensors (CHWV-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]], EAD1-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EAD1-O]], EAD2-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EAD2-O]], EF1-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF1-O]], EF2-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF2-O]], RAD-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.RAD-O]], and SF-O [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.SF-O]]).
- **Gaps and conflicts (problem):** Section D is missing from the sequence lettering [[issue:air-handling-unit-skips]], there is no fire alarm input point on AHU01 [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* for the section L shutdown [[issue:ai-air-handling-unit-gap-f02915c0]], and section B (scheduled occupancy) conflicts with section C (occupied at all times) [[issue:ai-air-handling-unit-conflict-beccff1e]].
- **Operation (unknown):** No live or trended BMS values are in the graph; check actual loop tracking, the TAB duct static setpoint, occupancy schedule mode, and fire alarm hardwiring on site or in BMS trends [[check:live|unit:AHU1]] [[m-0007]].

answers.question: Which points does AHU-1's cooling loop use, and are they on the BMS?
answers.text:
AHU01 (BMS device AHU-1) [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* uses three loop points and two interlock points for its cooling control (Section K), and all of them are on the BMS, though the valve output has a classification error [[seq:air-handling-unit/K]] [[src:3_sequences.pdf#p1]]:

- **Setpoint (`DA-SP`)**: Supply Air Temperature Setpoint (53 °F) [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DA-SP]] *likely* drives the chilled water valve output [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DA-SP|drives|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]] *likely* and matches the 53 °F sequence setpoint [[check:setpoint.K|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DA-SP]].
- **Measured (`DA-T`)**: Supply Air Temperature Sensor [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DA-T]] *unsure* provides feedback to the chilled water valve output [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.DA-T|feedback|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]] *likely*.
- **Output (`CHWV-O`)**: Chilled water 3-way valve output [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]] *unsure* is on the BMS as an analog output (AO), but fails the class check because it is misclassified as a `Chilled_Water_Flow_Sensor` [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]].
- **Enable / Lockout Interlocks (`MA-T`, `OA-T`)**: Mixed Air Temperature Sensor [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.MA-T]] *unsure* enables the cooling valve above 55 °F [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.MA-T|requires|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]] *unsure*, and Outside Air Temperature Sensor [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.OA-T]] *unsure* closes the valve below 40 °F [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.OA-T|requires|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.CHWV-O]] *likely* [[seq:air-handling-unit/K]].

answers.question: Where does the graph get AHU-1's cooling capacity from? Show me the page.
answers.text:
AHU-1's (tag AHU01) cooling capacity comes from the Air Handling Unit Schedule on sheet M-401, page 1 of `2_equipment_schedules.pdf` [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* [[src:2_equipment_schedules.pdf#p1]] [[m-0101]].

- **Total cooling capacity:** 1,367.2 MBH (`cooling_mbh`) [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* [[src:2_equipment_schedules.pdf#p1]].
- **Sensible cooling capacity:** 1,078.7 MBH (`cooling_sensible_mbh`) [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* [[src:2_equipment_schedules.pdf#p1]].
- **Coil conditions:** 84.1 / 67.0 °F entering air (`cooling_eat`), 53.1 / 53.1 °F leaving air (`cooling_lat`), and 183 GPM chilled water at 42 / 58 °F (`chw_gpm`, `chw_ewt_lwt`) [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* [[src:2_equipment_schedules.pdf#p1]].

answers.question: What building pressure should AHU-1 hold, and does the BMS setpoint agree with the sequence?
answers.text:
AHU01 (AHU-1) [[unit:AHU1]] *agreed* should hold a positive building pressure of **+0.02 in.wc** (adjustable), and the BMS setpoint agrees with the sequence [[seq:air-handling-unit/F]] [[check:setpoint.F|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.BLDGP-SP]].

- **Sequence of Operation (Sheet M-304, Section F):** States that the air handler references a building differential pressure sensor to maintain a positive pressurization of +0.02" wc (adj) by modulating the minimum outside air damper [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.MOA-O]] *unsure* and enabling/modulating the exhaust fan plenums [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF1-O]] *unsure* [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.EF2-O]] *unsure* if building pressure rises above +0.02" wc [[seq:air-handling-unit/F]] [[src:3_sequences.pdf#p1]].
- **BMS & Submittal Setpoint:** The point `BLDGP-SP` ("Building Pressure Setpoint (+0.02 in.wc)") [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.BLDGP-SP]] *likely* on controller `TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1` specifies `+0.02 in.wc`, matching the sequence [[check:setpoint.F|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.BLDGP-SP]] [[src:4_controls_submittal.pdf#p8]].
- **Live Verification:** Because there is no live BMS connection in the graph, the actual active setpoint value and measured building pressure (`BLDG-P` [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.AHU-1.BLDG-P]] *unsure*) in the running controller are unknown and must be checked on site [[check:live|unit:AHU1]] [[m-0007]].

answers.question: Does VAV01 run as designed?
answers.text:
Whether VAV01 [[unit:VAV1]] *agreed* actually runs as designed is unknown because there is no live BMS connection [[m-0007]], and on paper its setup has setpoint, classification, and sequence gaps [[check:live|unit:VAV1]].

- **Sequence (ok):** VAV01 [[unit:VAV1]] *agreed* follows the "Vav Terminal Units" sequence on sheet M-304 [[seq:vav-terminal-units]] [[src:3_sequences.pdf#p1]].
- **Control loops (ok):** All 3 published loops—airflow [[seq:vav-terminal-units/F]] (SA-F [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.SA-F]] *unsure*, SAFLOW-SP [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.SAFLOW-SP]] *likely*, DPR-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.DPR-O]] *unsure*), zone cooling [[seq:vav-terminal-units/F]] (ZN-T [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.ZN-T]] *unsure*, OCC-CLG-SP [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.OCC-CLG-SP]] *likely*, DPR-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.DPR-O]] *unsure*), and zone heating [[seq:vav-terminal-units/G]] (OCC-HTG-SP [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.OCC-HTG-SP]] *likely* driving DPR-O [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.DPR-O]] *unsure*)—have their mapped points on the BMS.
- **Interlocks and modes (ok):** Occupancy schedule switching is mapped from OCC-SCHEDULE to DPR-O [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.OCC-SCHEDULE|switches|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.DPR-O]] *stated* [[seq:vav-terminal-units/C]].
- **Setpoints (problem):** Section G specifies a 90 °F heating discharge air setpoint with no matching BMS point [[check:setpoint.G|unit:VAV1]] [[seq:vav-terminal-units/G]], while SAFLOW-SP [[check:setpoint.F|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.SAFLOW-SP]], OCC-CLG-SP [[check:setpoint.F|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.OCC-CLG-SP]], and OCC-HTG-SP [[check:setpoint.G|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.OCC-HTG-SP]] have no values in the BMS description or sequence.
- **Checks (problem):** Point ZN-SP [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.ZN-SP]] *unsure* fails the class check because it is an analog input (AI) classed as a Setpoint [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-2.VAV-01.ZN-SP]].
- **Gaps and conflicts (problem):** The sequence is missing section E [[issue:vav-terminal-units-skips]], calls for a 90 °F discharge air setpoint with no point on the VAVs [[issue:ai-vav-terminal-units-gap-c86ae875]], and describes electric reheat (HTG-E and HTG-O) in section G even though VAV01 [[unit:VAV1]] *agreed* and 18 other VAVs have no heater in the schedule or BMS [[issue:vav-terminal-units-reheat]] [[issue:ai-vav-terminal-units-gap-54015b66]] [[issue:ai-vav-terminal-units-gap-8e072687]] [[issue:ai-vav-terminal-units-gap-06082c61]].
- **Operation (unknown):** No live or trended BMS data exists in the graph; check live values, actual setpoints for SAFLOW-SP, OCC-CLG-SP, and OCC-HTG-SP, and damper tracking on site [[check:live|unit:VAV1]] [[m-0007]].

answers.question: Which checks fail on the lab exhaust fan EF-LAB?
answers.text:
On `EF-LAB` [[unit:EFLAB]] *agreed*, one SHACL check fails, and on the BMS units `EF-LAB1` [[unit:EFLAB1]] *likely* and `EF-LAB2` [[unit:EFLAB2]] *likely*, one point class check fails on each:

- **EF-LAB (`shacl.Entity`):** Fails because its `brick:hasLocation` value `floor:RF` is not typed as an instance of `brick:Location` [[unit:EFLAB]] *agreed* [[check:shacl.Entity|unit:EFLAB]]. (`EF-LAB` has 0 bound points, and its template, binding, class, and conflict checks pass [[check:template|unit:EFLAB]] [[check:binding|unit:EFLAB]] [[check:class|unit:EFLAB]] [[check:conflict|unit:EFLAB]].)
- **EF-LAB1 (`class`):** Fails on `EF-LAB-1-SPD` [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.EF-LAB-1.EF-LAB-1-SPD]] *unsure*, which is a binary output (BO) classed as a `Speed_Sensor` [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.EF-LAB-1.EF-LAB-1-SPD]].
- **EF-LAB2 (`class`):** Fails on `EF-LAB-2-SPD` [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.EF-LAB-2.EF-LAB-2-SPD]] *unsure*, which is a binary output (BO) classed as a `Speed_Sensor` [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.EF-LAB-2.EF-LAB-2-SPD]].

answers.text:
No, the documents disagree on which room FVAV01 [[unit:FVAV1]] *agreed* serves [[check:conflict|unit:FVAV1]] [[m-0001]]:

- **Controls submittal** (`4_controls_submittal.pdf`, sheet C-700, page 21): states FVAV01 serves Room **104 Administrative Work Area** [[src:4_controls_submittal.pdf#p21]] [[rel:unit:FVAV1|serves|room:104]].

answers.question: Does the chilled water plant run as designed?
answers.text:
On paper, the chilled water plant [[unit:CHWPLANT]] *likely* (chillers [[unit:CH1A]] *agreed* and [[unit:CH1B]] *agreed*, pumps [[unit:CWP1]] *agreed* and [[unit:CWP2]] *agreed*) has problems in its flow control loop, setpoints, checks, and sequence gaps, while actual operation is unknown because there is no live BMS data [[check:live|unit:CHWPLANT]] [[m-0007]].

- **Sequence (ok):** The plant and its equipment follow the "Chilled Water System" sequence on sheet M-304 [[seq:chilled-water-system]] [[src:3_sequences.pdf#p1]].
- **Loops (problem):** The chillers' leaving water temperature loops have all required BMS points with fitting classes (`LCHWT-SP`, `LEWT`, `CH-E`) [[seq:chilled-water-system/B]] [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CH-1A.LCHWT-SP]] *likely* [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CH-1B.LCHWT-SP]] *likely*, but the chilled water flow loop on [[unit:CHWPLANT]] *likely* has no setpoint point driving it and its pump speed outputs `CWP-1-O` [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-1.CWP-1-O]] *unsure* and `CWP-2-O` [[pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-2.CWP-2-O]] *unsure* are misclassified as `Speed_Sensor` [[seq:chilled-water-system/A]] [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-1.CWP-1-O]] [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-2.CWP-2-O]].
- **Interlocks (ok):** Lead/lag switching, isolation valves, flow proving (`CW-F`), pump status interlocks, and cooling/freeze requests are mapped without issues across the plant [[seq:chilled-water-system/A]] [[seq:chilled-water-system/B]] [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CHW-PLANT.CH-LEAD|switches|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CH-1A.CH-E]] *stated* [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CHW-PLANT.CWP-LEAD|switches|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-1.CWP-1-C]] *stated*.
- **Setpoints (problem):** The chillers' 42 °F leaving water setpoint points `LCHWT-SP` match the sequence and equipment schedule [[check:setpoint.B|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CH-1A.LCHWT-SP]] [[check:setpoint.B|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CH-1B.LCHWT-SP]] [[src:2_equipment_schedules.pdf#p1]], but `CHW-PLANT` has no setpoint point carrying 42 °F or the 140 gpm lag-chiller enable threshold [[check:setpoint.B|unit:CHWPLANT]] (though `LAG-ON-SP` exists on the plant interlocks [[rel:pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CHW-PLANT.LAG-ON-SP|requires|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CH-1A.CH-E]] *stated*).
- **Checks (problem):** `CWP-1-O` and `CWP-2-O` fail class checks as analog outputs classed as `Speed_Sensor` [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-1.CWP-1-O]] [[check:class|pt:TROOPD-NAE01/FC-1.CWP-2.CWP-2-O]], `CHW-PLANT` fails Brick `Collection`/`Equipment` SHACL shapes [[check:shacl.Collection|unit:CHWPLANT]] [[check:shacl.Equipment|unit:CHWPLANT]], and the chillers and pumps fail SHACL location checks on `room:144` [[check:shacl.Entity|unit:CH1A]] [[check:shacl.Entity|unit:CWP1]].
- **Gaps and conflicts (problem):** Sequence section A states the pumps control chilled water flow rate, but there is no chilled water flow setpoint point for the pumps [[issue:ai-chilled-water-system-gap-84ccbb31]].
- **Operation (unknown):** The graph has no live or trended BMS values; check the pump speed loop, lead/lag staging thresholds, and leaving water temperatures on site or in BMS trends [[check:live|unit:CHWPLANT]] [[m-0007]].
